titulo: Upstreaming Tyr: Rust, DRM, and the Linux Kernel (Collabora)
resumo: The Collabora blog provides an update on Tyr , a driver for Arm Mali GPUs. One of our biggest challenges has been developing Tyr while the Rust kernel abstractions and driver interfaces are also being developed. As the driver interfaces are naturally revised and improved, we have rewritten Tyr several times to adapt to the larger Rust ecosystem. This not only makes progress much slower than it would be with a mature API, but also stalls progress for capabilities, such as job scheduling, while the abstraction is properly designed, reviewed, tested, and merged upstream. But working in this evolving environment is also precisely where Tyr is able to provide the most value. As a user of these new Rust abstractions, Tyr helps to expose their requirements and limitations.

The PHP security team, operating on consensus, struggled to choose between these and feared the repercussions of shipping the wrong choice. Combined with the lack of a known path to remote code execution and the small team of core developers with the necessary deep knowledge of the engine occupied with many responsibilities, this decision process caused work on a fix to stall and restart repeatedly over months. Em agosto deste ano, o Fundo de Investimento Público da Arábia Saudita (PIF), a Silver Lake e a Affinity Partners concluíram a aquisição da Electronic Arts por US$ 55 bilhões. Como parte do negócio, a publisher assumiu uma dívida de US$ 18 bilhões , conforme apontado pelo jornalista Jason Schreier. Basicamente, a EA vai pagar a conta da própria aquisição .
